items.q: Is the built-in bra actually supportive?
items.a: Yes. The cami has a built-in wireless bra with gentle, secure support that lifts and holds your bust without underwire digging or pinching. It's designed for everyday, all-day comfort.

items.q: What sizes does it come in?
items.a: S through 4XL. Our sizing is based on your usual top or dress size. Check the size chart on this page, and remember exchanges are free within 60 days if you need a different size.

items.q: How does the free gift work?
items.a: Add at least one Sweetheart Cami to your order and you automatically unlock a free Best-Selling Shaper Bottom (worth $26). Just pick your size when you check out, while supplies last.
60-day returns and free size exchanges. If the fit isn't perfect, swap it for any size, color, or style. No questions asked.
